details.description: Speechmatics' Standard operating point for real-time (streaming) speech-to-text, delivered over a WebSocket connection. It is the faster, higher-throughput of Speechmatics' two real-time models; the maker recommends it when throughput or latency matter more than maximum accuracy, such as archival transcription, content indexing or large-scale captioning. Standard is feature-identical to Speechmatics' Enhanced operating point, supporting the same 55+ languages and language packs, bilingual packs, translation to/from English, and real-time speaker diarization, differing from Enhanced only in its accuracy/speed trade-off.
advantages: Speechmatics documents Standard as its fastest real-time operating point, prioritizing throughput over the maximum accuracy that its Enhanced operating point targets.
Feature-identical to Enhanced: supports the same 55+ languages and language packs, bilingual packs, and translation to/from English for most languages.
Real-time speaker diarization labels up to 50 speakers by default, configurable up to 100.
Also supports custom dictionaries, turn detection for voice assistants, and speaker identification through voice-profile enrollment on streaming audio.
disadvantages: Speechmatics documents Standard as trading maximum accuracy for throughput; its Enhanced operating point is recommended instead when accuracy matters most, such as medical or legal work.
Automatic language detection is available only with Speechmatics' Batch transcription, not Realtime, so the language or language pack must be set explicitly for streaming audio.

notes: The catalog id 'real-time-standard' is Speechmatics' Standard operating point used with the Realtime API (the older `operating_point` config field is being superseded by a `model` field per the docs, but Standard itself is not deprecated). No 0-100 accuracy benchmark for this exact operating point was found on the maker's pages, so evaluations is empty.
